Frigate Identity Service — person re-identification for Frigate NVR.
Maintains identity continuity for detected persons using facial recognition (from Frigate) as the primary source and ReID (re-identification) embeddings as a fallback when faces are not visible. Publishes identity events and per-person snapshots over MQTT for use in Home Assistant dashboards, automations, and the companion Frigate Identity HA integration.
Supports amd64 and aarch64. Runs on CPU (no GPU required). Connects to your existing MQTT broker and Frigate NVR instance over the local network.
Source: https://github.com/awayman/frigate_identity_service HA Integration: https://github.com/awayman/frigate-identity-ha
